metadata.description: One Cursor plugin with the unslop-ui skill, a portable adaptation of Damir Sokolovsky's unslop UI skill. Component discovery is limited to cursor-plugins/unslop-ui-portable. This marketplace has no hooks, MCP servers, rules, agents, commands, or installer.

plugins.name: unslop-ui-portable
plugins.description: Portable adaptation of Damir Sokolovsky's unslop UI skill, named unslop-ui to avoid colliding with the writing skill named unslop. Keeps snapshot and story-video scripts. CC BY 4.0.
